issue_title: Slow LLM response blocks heartbeat emitter causing premature task recovery
issue_description: LLM call taking 45s causes recovery sweeper to mark attempt ABANDONED while still running.
error_log: stale attempt warning: worker heartbeat expired after 30s threshold during long LLM call
expected_root_cause: Heartbeat ticker ran in the same goroutine as synchronous LLM request instead of dedicated background goroutine
